working_tree: Local uncommitted adaptation; artifact SHA-256 values identify the executed runtime, dependencies, and tests.
scope: Local automated protocol/browser verification. No human usability review, game playtest, public deployment, or model evaluation.

environment.browser_mode: Headless system Chromium with --no-sandbox in the cloud container

origin.selection: Exactly three P11 files; no Rave source extracted. Archive and per-file hashes verified before extraction. Historical snapshots and source inventory unchanged.

baseline.dependency_note: Used installed Express 4.22.3 and Socket.IO 4.8.4, within the unchanged source package ranges; not an exact historical dependency installation.
baseline.observation: Server logged message: First participant. The sender browser never rendered it; expectMessages timed out after 4000 ms. Neither source file contains a broadcast/receive path.
baseline.diagnosis: Missing server broadcast and browser receive/render implementation, not a browser startup or dependency failure.

install.note: Frozen reinstall completed before the final 15-test run. npm cache relocated from a non-writable home directory; verification settings unchanged.

saved_script_check.result: Version gates, frozen npm install, and documentary validator all completed.

tests.name: protocol broadcasts trimmed messages to sender and peer in order
non-string payloads are rejected without broadcasts
empty and whitespace-only payloads are rejected without broadcasts
501 code units are rejected even when trimming would shorten the payload
500 UTF-16 code units are accepted including non-ASCII text
messages without acknowledgement callbacks do not crash the server
two browser clients display accepted messages once in both directions
markup remains literal text in both browsers
rejection is visible, preserves the draft, and does not broadcast
a departed client keeps its draft and receives only future messages on rejoining
transport interruption reconnects automatically without duplicating listeners
browser retains only the latest 200 messages
new browser receives future messages without server-side history
missing acknowledgement reports uncertainty and does not retry automatically
an acknowledgement does not erase a newer draft typed during sending

checks: Two connected Socket.IO clients both receive CLI startup smoke; acknowledgement is {ok: true}
startup_smoke.cleanup: Legacy and working CLI servers stopped after verification; test servers closed by test hooks.

documentary_check.scope: Maintained lab documents and registries; no dependency-package Markdown.

manifest_check.scope: All maintained lab files except the manifest itself; dependency and generated files excluded using Git ignore rules. Final closure output establishes the check result.
manifest_check.baseline_issue: Inherited manifest referenced two absent nested files (.gitignore, .gitattributes). Their entries are removed; the new root .gitignore is outside the nested manifest scope.

limitations: Automated Chromium checks only; no human usability or formal accessibility review.
No other browser, public hosting, accounts, persistence, rate/scale study, or guaranteed outage recovery tested.
Manual resend after lost acknowledgement can duplicate an already delivered message.
No model candidate or cross-project destination consumer executed; transfer records remain candidates.
Historical combat/dialogue reports were not rerun in this session.

contribution.Martin: Provided portfolio direction, source context, and authorization; no manual review/test attributed.
contribution.Codex: Assessment, prioritization, working adaptation, automated verification, continuity updates, and evidence capture in this session.

validator_regression.baseline_diagnosis: After P11 installation, validator scanned node_modules and reported upstream links not shipped with dependencies.
validator_regression.correction: Prune node_modules and .git while keeping all maintained documents, registry validation, and archive/file hash checks.
tests: Source archive hash corruption still fails
validator_regression.scope: Isolated temporary fixtures with current registry/archive copies; tracked historical material unchanged.

fault_injection.browser_rejoin: Client Socket.IO disconnect/connect; missing messages are not replayed.
fault_injection.transport_reconnect: Explicitly closed the client Engine.IO transport and observed automatic reconnect with a new socket ID.
fault_injection.lost_and_delayed_acknowledgements: Controlled server-handler replacements inside browser tests; not a real network packet-loss study.

visual_inspection.method: Codex inspected rendered screenshots of the working UI at 820x780 and 375x740; browser confirmed no horizontal overflow at 375px.
visual_inspection.outcome: Message text, connection state, labelled composer, and footer remain legible in these samples.
visual_inspection.limits: Agent inspection only; no Martin review, assistive-technology audit, or full device/browser study. Screenshots kept in temporary storage, not presented as creative assets.

environment_configuration.runtime_note: Script was tested locally before saving; draft save itself does not execute scripts, publish, or restart services.
